svg.title: One question, three evidence routes
svg.desc: Classify intent, select one retrieval tool, and pass its evidence to the matching generation function.
svg.text: Classify intent, select one retrieval tool, and pass its evidence to the matching generation function.
Exactly one route executes per question.
Unknown routes fall back to hybrid search.
Current interface: backend Python / CLI. Flutter chat still generates local responses; no chat HTTP or SSE route is wired.
